name: Various Awards to Individuals/Organizations who have made Outstanding Contributions in the Field of Social Welfare
benefit: - Under this scheme, individuals and organizations receive various awards in recognition of their exceptional contributions to social welfare.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be either an individual or an organization. - If the applicant is an individual, they should be a resident of Gujarat; if an organization, it should operate within Gujarat. - The applicant should have made outstanding contributions in the field of social welfare. - The contributions should specifically benefit or directly impact the Scheduled Caste (SC) community in Gujarat.
